options.summary: Accept branches solely by abs_demographic_parity_diff_mean, the primary Fairness_fairlearn metric.
evidence: Degenerate all-negative predictor achieves validation and test abs_demographic_parity_diff_mean 0.000000
risks: Metric can be gamed by predicting only one class.

options.summary: Require executable code and a minimum utility guardrail such as balanced accuracy before accepting any claimed fairness improvement.
evidence: Original baseline test DPD 0.173030 with balanced accuracy 0.763862
API-repaired candidate runs but worsens test DPD to 0.317603 despite balanced accuracy 0.818491
Degenerate all-negative candidate has perfect DPD 0.000000 but balanced accuracy 0.500000
risks: Requires explicit multi-metric acceptance criteria for fairness tasks.

human_decision: Reject primary-metric-only acceptance; require executable code plus a balanced-accuracy utility floor before any Fairness_fairlearn branch can continue.
rationale: The target fairness metric alone rewards a degenerate classifier. A human evaluator gate should prevent both non-executable candidates and metric-gaming candidates from consuming continuation budget.

required_before_continuation: primary fairness metric improves over baseline
balanced accuracy remains above a baseline-relative utility floor
downstream_budget.recommended_next_step: design a non-degenerate Fairlearn-compatible candidate before matched continuation

follow_up_checks: Define an explicit balanced-accuracy threshold before the next Fairness run.
Report fairness results as evaluator-gate evidence unless a non-degenerate candidate passes both fairness and utility checks.
Keep demographic parity and equalized odds metrics separated in future summaries.
